ValidationRule.description: If the status is updated to Mktg Only Closed and the user tries to save without entering a reason, a message should show asking them to enter one.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Marketing Only - Closed"), OR( ISCHANGED(Status), ISCHANGED(Closed_Reason__c) ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Closed_Reason__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a reason for moving the record to Closed
